title: The Timber Rights
subtitle: A break by block tag
description: `blockTag` counts any block in a tag, so thirty-two logs is thirty-two of whatever the tag holds — oak, birch, spruce, or the stems of the nether. It is its own field rather than a `#` in `block`, so a tag where an id is expected is an error here as it is everywhere else.
A tag task keeps the pickaxe on its row rather than wearing one member's item: a picture naming oak would be a promise the quest does not make.
